tested_environment: Recovered source on macOS. Node module, interaction, scanner, storage, asset-integrity tests passed. Camp home screen inspected in local browser preview. Physical iPhone and standalone installation not tested.

build.observation: Buildless ES-module production files. Every first-party *.js passed node --check. There is no framework compiler or type-checker.

functional.observation: A synthetic worksheet was recognized, the scan journey reached the games, and all eleven game entry points were exercised in the managed browser. Independent tests exercised retries, completion, generated puzzle integrity, memory progression and scan parsing.

visual.observation: Live camp preview inspected at a narrow viewport; game list and spelling practice exercised. Full multi-viewport audit is pending.

persistence.observation: Node tests passed storage round trip, normalization, malformed-state fallback, scheduling and storage quota failure. Browser save/relaunch/restore is not yet verified.

accessibility.observation: Visual word clues, labelled controls and reduced-motion handling exist. A screen reader, focus and contrast audit was not performed in this checkpoint.

performance.observation: Static assets total about 7.2 MiB, including the on-demand OCR runtime. No phone timing or memory profile was captured.

mobile.observation: The camera file chooser, on-screen keyboard, real touch and Safari safe areas require additional device verification.

production.observation: GitHub Pages build succeeded. Live camp, all eleven game links, Echo Hollow spelling submission and star award, and camera/photo entry controls verified. No browser console errors observed.

distribution.observation: Live manifest, app icons and service-worker source included. Physical iPhone standalone installation remains unverified.

github.observation: Published to main. All 51 Wordgrove file blob SHAs match the local publication manifest.

offline_update.observation: Service worker installation, offline relaunch and upgrade behavior have not been recorded in this checkpoint.

visual_identity.observation: A consistent woodland theme is visible in original game artwork and the camp interface.
visual_identity.remaining_weakness: No attached multi-viewport visual evidence at this checkpoint.

usability.observation: The managed-browser photo journey reached the game collection. Manual word entry and visual word clues are available.
usability.remaining_weakness: Navigation has not been observed with a first grader.

interaction.observation: Interactive tests exercised tactile letter choices, retry, memory progression and cleanup. Randomized tests exercised the three puzzle engines.
interaction.remaining_weakness: Gameplay pacing was not measured with a child.

reliability.observation: The bundled OCR model recognized the printed fixture, and the game logic passed targeted interaction and randomized tests.
reliability.remaining_weakness: Physical-device camera input and offline update remain unverified.

accessibility.observation: Game controls use labels and text fallbacks; the layout honors reduced-motion preferences.
accessibility.remaining_weakness: No physical-device VoiceOver audit or formal contrast scan.

delivery.observation: Full source committed to GitHub and Pages game reachable. README includes installation guidance.
delivery.remaining_weakness: Physical iPhone standalone installation remains unverified.

verification_limits: Physical iPhone camera, standalone installation, VoiceOver, and offline/upgrade behavior have not been exercised on a physical device.
